mapping.draft_py:
# Lotus Field. Kept from the compiler: Hexproof (keyword) and "This land enters tapped." (EtBState).
# 3. "When this land enters, sacrifice two lands." -- Crypt Lurker's SACRIFICE (B2a-crypt-lurker)
#    over lands you control, count 2, mandatory.
etb_sac = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.SACRIFICE, {
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=2),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAnd(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
            )),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
# 4. "{T}: Add three mana of any one color." -- parse "{T}: Add two mana of any one color."
#    (frame B13-activated+B5a-add-any-color) with amount 3.
mana = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostTap(),)),
    effect=A(Verb.ADD_MANA, {'amount': QConst(value=3), 'color': 'ANY', 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
)
abilities = [*compiled, etb_sac, mana]
